constraints:
## How to call
- Static site; open `/` in a modern browser.
- Binds `0.0.0.0`; LAN clients use `http://192.168.1.21:18473`.
- No authentication. Do not expose publicly without an access-control layer.
- The collector is an offline maintenance script and is not invoked over HTTP.
- Mistake-review data is stored server-side in `data/mistakes.json` via `/api/mistakes` (browser localStorage is only a cache/offline fallback), so it survives restarts and is shared by every client on this origin.
- Terminal management: `./run.sh review [list|remove <id>|clear]`.

extra.install: No dependencies; Python standard library only.
